title: Reader (Mac): editions off gives a plain stream reader with no edition paths
description: FRONTEND, DONE ON THE MAC against a dev server. With editions off the package reader exposes no /YYYY/month/DD, archive or edition masthead; home is the newest-items stream, items at flat slugs, sections as filters. No rolling-edition fallback, no redirects. Replace the empty-edition promo placeholder with a neutral empty state. TI home becomes its posts feed (DatedPostList, published-post-repository exist). p.apyr.us: remove readerBasePath /information and legacyRedirects.mjs; the Papyrus publication is served at read.p.apyr.us.
